eventDetail.scope: The Computational Imaging Symposium is one of the most active venues for research at the intersection of optics, signal processing, machine learning, and imaging systems. CISym brings together researchers working across the full pipeline of computational imaging: from physics and optics through algorithm design, learning-based methods, and application domains.
